description.value:
Over a long rest, using astrotech's implements, you rebuild them into a mobile electronic warfare platform. It becomes an enhanced item usable only by you, requires attunement, and serves as a tech focus for your tech powers while attuned. It starts with 4 modification slots, gaining more at higher levels per the engineer table's Modification Slots column. Each modification beyond your proficiency bonus reduces your tech point maximum by 1. During a long rest you may install, swap, or remove modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one); any effect requiring a save uses your tech save DC.

The platform projects three possible fields — ionizing, jamming, and targeting. As a bonus action you switch one on for 1 minute; only one field can run at a time, though you can shut it off on your turn at no cost. The field's radius grows to 15 feet at 9th level and 30 feet at 17th level. You have a combined number of activations equal to your proficiency bonus (see the engineer table), all restored after a long rest.

Ionizing Field. Any droid or construct besides you that starts its turn within 5 feet of you gains 4 slowed levels and takes ion damage equal to half your engineer level.

Jamming Field. When you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must save against a tech power, that creature adds your Intelligence modifier (at least +1) to the save.

Targeting Field. You and friendly creatures within 5 feet of you add your Intelligence modifier (at least +1) to the first ranged weapon damage roll each makes per round.
